title: Controlled vs uncontrolled inputs
expectedPositive: Type `Practice HTTP` using the keyboard and submit; the output must reflect the text. Submitting an empty or two-character title must not update the output.
expectedNegative: The title is hard-coded and never updated by the registered field.
securityBoundary: The browser must validate for usability, but the HTTP server still checks the 3–100 character title and allowed priorities.
